set.body:
Defect: SD5 -- no new module, dependency or public vocabulary without an ADR line.

Do: Write the ADR. Read the free number from origin/main (0018 was free at 43140bcb; it has moved three times in two days). Record: the ten-instance diagnosis; the two guarantees; the corpus / corpus-intake split; circe-core+parser in `corpus` directly (codec cannot host the parser -- it depends on view/align/recall/interview and corpus-intake would drag the stack in); the private[corpus] ceiling admitting the whole storymodel4s.corpus.* tree incl. corpus-intake and its tests; JDK StAX over a new XML dependency; name collisions (CorpusProfile vs interview.scoring.Profile Scoring.scala:347; LinkEvidence vs core.Evidence claim.scala:29; RecallRow/RecallSpan vs recall.RecallUnit unit.scala:124); error strategy (accumulate cell refusals per sheet under a declared cap, fail fast on structural); the fate of tools/corpus/xlsx_rows.py.

Tests: n/a (document).

Exit: ADR committed recording all rejected alternatives: (i) one JVM-only module (design contract rule 11); (ii) extending `acquire`, which is the agent-proposal protocol and already wrongly hosts a corpus parser; (iii) lifting NfrdBaseballVerifier wholesale -- it is participant-keyed and retains no bytes, so only four primitives move.

Plan: docs/plans/2026-09-17-annotation-intake-contract.md S1, P0
